pick.headline: Hijackers storm Pan Am Flight 73 at Karachi

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 172, 5 September 1986
evidence.snippet: FBIS MIDDLE EAST & SOUTH DAILY REPORT ASIA REVIEW 5 SEPTEMBER 1986 Hijacking of Pam Am Plane “The Libyan Revolutionary Cells” were responsible for hijacking the U.S. airliner at Karachi Airport and their “revolutionary fighters” will “pass the death sentence” on U.S. “intelligence officials” on board the plane, a caller told a news agency in Cyprus in a statement reported by AFP.
